svg.text: label per Stage-B problem (YES / PARTIAL / NO / UNKNOWN) — hover for the missing information

g.title: Loss of early star contests: PARTIAL — missing: any signal of the opponents' bidding propensity before sales reveal it; per-lot competing-bid strength beyond pooled aggregates (the three capacity features are saturated)
Bids change with purse rather than opponent behaviour: YES — missing: nothing structural at room level; lot-level competition is only weakly encoded (see early stars)
g.text: Bids change with purse rather than opponent behaviour

g.title: Pressure from multiple aggressive RL opponents: PARTIAL — missing: count / identity of aggressive rivals; per-rival purse and recent spend; buyer identity in the 20-lot window
g.text: Pressure from multiple aggressive RL opponents

g.title: Squad / overseas slots filling while purse remains: YES — missing: rivals' overseas / squad-slot counts (not needed to see the own-state problem)
g.text: Squad / overseas slots filling while purse remains

g.title: Wicketkeeper completion failures when rivals stockpile keepers: PARTIAL — missing: willingness / capacity of rivals that do NOT need a keeper to buy one; per-rival keeper holdings; which rival bought recent keepers
g.text: Wicketkeeper completion failures when rivals stockpile keepers

g.title: Later requirement completion and greater shield dependence: PARTIAL — missing: competition for requirement players from rivals that do not need them; unsaturated bowling / Indian scarcity
g.text: Later requirement completion and greater shield dependence

g.title: Seed-specific weaknesses: UNKNOWN — missing: not an observation question on the available data
